props.description: The date: a `Date`, or an ISO 8601 string as an API sends it. An invalid date draws nothing.
props.name: date

props.description:
What the date means; `date` (the default) shows no state, `due` can be due soon or overdue, `expiry` can be
expiring soon or expired.
props.name: kind

props.description: How many days ahead a due date or expiry counts as soon; defaults to 3. A market pack can change it.
props.name: soonDays

props.description:
True (the default) to write a date within a week as "tomorrow" or "3 days ago"; the full date is always read
out and shown on hover.
props.name: isRelative

props.description: The calendar the full date is written in; defaults to `gregory`.
props.name: calendar

props.description: "Now", for a fixed point in a test or a demo; defaults to the moment the label mounted.
props.name: now

props.description: False to skip the single attention pulse an overdue or expired label plays when it appears.
props.name: isAnimated

props.description: The emphasis of the chip: filled, neutral, transparent or tinted. Defaults to `secondary`.
props.name: variant

props.description: An element drawn before the text, on the inline-start side: an icon name or any icon element, sized to the text.
props.name: startIcon

props.description: An element drawn after the text, on the inline-end side: an icon name or any icon element, sized to the text.
props.name: endIcon

props.description:
Overrides the default DOM element with a custom render function.
This allows rendering existing components with built-in styles and behaviors
such as router links, animation libraries, and pre-styled components.

Requirements:

* You must render the expected element type (e.g. if `<button>` is expected, you cannot render an `<a>`).
* Only a single root DOM element can be rendered (no fragments).
* You must pass through props and ref to the underlying DOM element, merging with your own prop as appropriate.
props.name: render

props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
props.name: ref
